compiled_state.title: As an agent operator, the merge workflow automatically remediates Tier 1 (llm-review) CI failures
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Create lib/ci-findings-normalize.sh with a versioned Tier 1 schema; add _phase_remediate to merge-to-main-pr.sh that downloads CI artifacts, normalizes reviewer-findings.json, dispatches review-fix-dispatch, pushes fix commits, and re-polls CI checks.

**Why**: Walking skeleton that proves the full CI artifact → normalize → fix → push → re-poll integration end-to-end before subsequent stories extend it.

**Scope**:
- IN: lib/ci-findings-normalize.sh (Tier 1 schema, schema_version field); _phase_remediate function skeleton in merge-to-main-pr.sh; gh run download pinned to failed run ID; review-fix-dispatch dispatch for Tier 1; push fix commit after FIXES_APPLIED; re-poll CI; exit 2 for remediation exhaustion
- OUT: Tiers 2/3/4 normalizers (→S2); conflict detection (→S3); per-tier/global counters and bounding (→S4); full escalation JSON payload (→S4)

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, a PR with a failing llm-review check causes _phase_remediate to trigger, download reviewer-findings.json from CI artifacts pinned to the specific failed run ID (not "latest"), normalize it into review-fix-dispatch findings format, and dispatch review-fix-dispatch
  ← Satisfies: "SC1: The remediation loop classifies CI check failures into four tiers and dispatches the appropriate fix strategy per tier"
- When this story is complete, lib/ci-findings-normalize.sh emits a versioned JSON schema (schema_version field) whose Tier 1 shape matches review-fix-dispatch's expected findings format exactly, validated by a schema-conformance test that S2 and S4 reuse
  ← Satisfies: "SC1: Tier definitions and normalizer format are specified in lib/ci-findings-normalize.sh"
- When this story is complete, after a FIXES_APPLIED result from review-fix-dispatch, the script pushes the fix commit and re-polls CI checks via _phase_poll
  ← Satisfies: "SC5: The full remediation loop runs end-to-end"
- When this story is complete, unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic in lib/ci-findings-normalize.sh and _phase_remediate

## Considerations

- [Testing] gh run download requires gh CLI + live GitHub connection — ensure mock-compatible interface for unit tests
- [Testing] review-fix-dispatch sub-agent dispatch must be mockable to avoid live LLM calls in tests
- [Reliability] Pin artifact download to the specific failed run ID captured from _phase_poll, not "latest" — prevents stale artifact race
- [Consumer Impact] merge-to-main.sh routes to merge-to-main-pr.sh based on merge.strategy config; --resume logic reads /tmp/merge-to-main-state-<branch>.json. Adding remediation_phase + counter fields must not break state-file parsing for pre-remediation state files still within the 4h TTL window (graceful forward-compat required)
- [Security] CI artifacts may contain sensitive data (tokens, API keys in test output) — normalizer must not log raw artifact content

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
